## Project contact

[igor.eulaers@npolar.no](mailto:igor.eulaers@npolar.no)

For questions about the project's mandate and scope, contact the
[PAME Secretariat](https://pame.is/) or the
[CAFF Secretariat](https://caff.is/).

## Contributing a layer or a correction

The value of ACTAME depends on the layers in it being right, current and
properly documented. If you hold a spatial dataset relevant to Arctic
area-based conservation, or you spot an error in how a layer is described:

1. **Open an issue** on the relevant repository — see the
   [Tools](tools.qmd) page for links. This is the fastest route for anything
   concerning the dashboard, the atlas text or the metadata.
2. **Get in touch directly** if the contribution is a dataset rather than a
   correction, so that provenance, licensing and the metadata record can be
   agreed before it is added.

Contributions are credited per layer in the Atlas and Metadata components.

## Reuse and licensing

The ACTAME software is open source; each repository states its licence. The
content of this website is available under
[CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Spatial layers carry the licences of their original providers and are credited
per entry — check the layer's metadata record before redistributing it.

## Attribution

Basemaps © [Arctic SDI](https://arctic-sdi.org/) and the
[Norwegian Polar Institute](https://www.npolar.no/). Boundary and area-based
measure layers are credited to their sources in the Atlas and Metadata
components of the dashboard.
